# Video deliverables

- [`it-hr-help-desk-triage.mp4`](https://github.com/anujb-msft/voice-ai-template-gallery/releases/download/demo-films/it-hr-help-desk-triage.mp4) — narrated demo film (2:28), on the [`demo-films`](https://github.com/anujb-msft/voice-ai-template-gallery/releases/tag/demo-films) release
- [`it-hr-help-desk-triage-walkthrough.mp4`](https://github.com/anujb-msft/voice-ai-template-gallery/releases/download/demo-films/it-hr-help-desk-triage-walkthrough.mp4) — the full narrated walkthrough (5:57), on the same release
- [`poster.webp`](./poster.webp) — poster image
- [`captions.vtt`](./captions.vtt) — captions for every spoken line
- [`transcript.md`](./transcript.md) — transcript with timecodes
- [`walkthrough-transcript.md`](./walkthrough-transcript.md) — the walkthrough's transcript

A short film of the template at work. It opens cold on a call, then shows the template's
own demo console at the moments that say what it does, in 3 chapters (It answers, Proof first, It escalates),
and closes on how it is built and how to make it yours. Every clip is cut from the full
walkthrough, where each call plays out from start to finish. The calls' lines are burned in
as subtitles; `captions.vtt` has every spoken line, the narrator's too.

| Film time | Shows | Walkthrough time |
|---|---|---|
| 0:00 | Sensitive calls go to HR. Privately. | 3:34–3:39, 3:39–3:48 |
| 0:32 | Approved articles only. Matched, not guessed. | 1:03–1:17 |
| 0:46 | Nothing is filed until you say yes. | 1:29–1:38, 1:47–1:55 |
| 1:05 | Caller ID is a hint. A code is proof. | 2:17–2:25, 2:34–2:40 |
| 1:19 | Wrong code? Nothing personal is read out. | 2:47–2:54, 3:00–3:06 |
| 1:34 | Phishing? Priority 1. By rule. | 4:12–4:23 |
| 1:45 | On-call sees the P1 before picking up. | 4:44–4:52 |

## Production details

- **Runtime:** 148.4 seconds (2:28), 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264 High with
  48 kHz stereo AAC-LC audio.
- **Voices:** all 25 lines are performed by Azure OpenAI GPT Realtime
  (`gpt-realtime`) through Azure AI Voice Live (api-version `2026-04-10`): `cedar` (Narrator), `alloy` (Sam), `marin` (Agent).
  The calls are the recordings the walkthrough was made with.
- **Footage:** the template's demo console from [`code/`](../code/), running in
  simulation mode, as the walkthrough recorded it. Clips labelled "Teams panel simulated" show the console's simulation of the Teams call
  panel.
- **Motion graphics:** a HyperFrames composition generated by
  [`scripts/video`](../../../../scripts/video/) (`npm run reel -- it-hr-help-desk-triage`) from
  [`reel/it-hr-help-desk-triage.mjs`](../../../../scripts/video/reel/it-hr-help-desk-triage.mjs).
- **Music:** an original score synthesised in code by
  [`score.mjs`](../../../../scripts/video/src/score.mjs), with no samples and no
  licensed music. It ducks under every voice.
- **Mix:** -16.0 LUFS integrated (target -16), true peak -2.4 dBTP.

Every voice is synthetic, performed by Azure OpenAI GPT Realtime through Azure AI Voice Live. Callers, companies and numbers are fictional. The console was recorded in simulation mode; its Teams panel is simulated.

The film demonstrates a reference implementation in simulation mode; it is not a
recording of a production deployment.
